description: Security headers audit policy for scripts/security/headers-audit.mjs. Profiles mirror the two runtime modes of src/lib/security-headers.ts: `next dev` (development, no HSTS) and `next start` (production, HSTS on).

development.description: next dev / non-production. HSTS is intentionally absent; the safe CSP subset is enforced and the full policy is report-only.

requiredHeaders.name: Content-Security-Policy
requiredHeaders.description: Safe CSP subset must be enforced on every response.

requiredHeaders.name: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only
requiredHeaders.description: Fuller policy must ship as report-only outside CSP_ENFORCE.

optionalHeaders.name: Strict-Transport-Security
optionalHeaders.description: HSTS is production-only; presence in dev is unexpected but not exploitable.

csp.note: In development the enforced CSP is intentionally a safe subset (frame-ancestors/base-uri/object-src); directive coverage is therefore checked against the report-only header.

production.description: next start / NODE_ENV=production. HSTS is required; CSP_ENFORCE=1 promotes the full policy to the enforced header and drops the report-only duplicate.

requiredHeaders.name: Content-Security-Policy
requiredHeaders.description: CSP must be enforced on every response.

requiredHeaders.name: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only
requiredHeaders.description: Absent when CSP_ENFORCE=1 (full policy enforced directly) — expected, not a failure.

requiredHeaders.name: Strict-Transport-Security
requiredHeaders.description: HSTS must be present in production with a max-age of at least 8 digits (~115 days).

csp.note: coverage=auto prefers the report-only header when present (safe-subset mode) and falls back to the enforced header (CSP_ENFORCE=1 full-policy mode); either way the full directive set must be covered.
